limitations: Prototype matchesa6dc0fbc plus complete-sample capacity growth. Physical Q10/s8 footprint law/radius/friction and all final budgets are unchanged; count every physical sample, grow before fit, copy successful unaffected profiles and replay producers before consumers. CUDA-only frontier compaction; CPU route remains full storage. Minimum1-slot placeholder is the smallest tensor allowed by Quadrants. B16v1 zero-size allocation failure is preserved. First expanded-native full-field harness mistakenly reused aggregate forces as raw loads and used a CUDA cached entrypoint with disabled CPU arrays; these failed fixtures are preserved. Corrected fresh-raw input/backend entrypoint yieldsCPU31/CUDA31 and96 independent full fields without relaxing acceptance. Each matched live pair includes600 warmup and three1280-step changing trajectories/all environments/reset/history/fallback/metrics. B2048 telemetry failed from missing UUID prefix; no peak-memory claim there. B8192 monitor uses actual assigned UUID and200ms sampling, includes setup and trajectories, and is a sampled bound rather than exact transient maximum. All source/raw/stored hashes verified. Prototype has measured memory savings but is not selected yet; fused capacity checks, serial-tail candidate, broader final scopes/seeds and plateau remain pending. No physical convergence or RL training claim.
